long_biography.plain_text:
Regia gives Maria Laura “Lalla” Pasquotti an economic interest in one of the Benetton family branches that continues within Edizione. Her daughter Sabrina became the branch's representative and chair, separating Pasquotti's role as heir and shareholder from day-to-day leadership. Edizione's portfolio now covers transport, digital infrastructure, travel retail, clothing, property, agriculture and finance.

Pasquotti also served on the board of AREP in Villorba, a rehabilitation organisation founded by the Benetton family in 1983. The centre delivered outpatient and day rehabilitation for people with physical, psychological and sensory disabilities. She left the board before its 2015 renewal, when the organisation brought several outside professionals into its governing body.
